appeals_decision_note_check.name: appeals_decision_note_check
appeals_decision_note_check.value: "appeals"."decision_note" is null or char_length("appeals"."decision_note") between 1 and 1000

case_studies_unavailable_check.name: case_studies_unavailable_check
case_studies_unavailable_check.value: ("case_studies"."status" = 'unavailable') = ("case_studies"."unavailable_at" is not null) and ("case_studies"."unavailable_reason" is null or "case_studies"."unavailable_reason" in ('withdrawn', 'replaced'))

claim_evidence_kind_check.name: claim_evidence_kind_check
claim_evidence_kind_check.value:
("claim_evidence"."log_entry_id" is not null and "claim_evidence"."log_revision_id" is not null and "claim_evidence"."artifact_version_id" is null)
        or ("claim_evidence"."log_entry_id" is null and "claim_evidence"."log_revision_id" is null and "claim_evidence"."artifact_version_id" is not null)

consents_note_check.name: consents_note_check
consents_note_check.value: "consents"."note" is null or char_length("consents"."note") between 1 and 300

embargoes_scope_target_check.name: embargoes_scope_target_check
embargoes_scope_target_check.value: ("embargoes"."scope" = 'project' and "embargoes"."project_id" is not null and "embargoes"."course_term_id" is null) or ("embargoes"."scope" = 'course_term' and "embargoes"."course_term_id" is not null and "embargoes"."project_id" is null)

endorsements_note_check.name: endorsements_note_check
endorsements_note_check.value: "endorsements"."note" is null or char_length("endorsements"."note") between 1 and 500

moderation_actions_reversed_check.name: moderation_actions_reversed_check
moderation_actions_reversed_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."reversed_at" is null) = ("moderation_actions"."reverse_cause" is null) and ("moderation_actions"."reverse_cause" is null or "moderation_actions"."reverse_cause" in ('lift', 'appeal')) and ("moderation_actions"."reversed_at" is null or "moderation_actions"."kind" <> 'none')

moderation_actions_item_check.name: moderation_actions_item_check
moderation_actions_item_check.value: ("moderation_actions"."kind" <> 'hide_item') or ("moderation_actions"."item_kind" is not null and "moderation_actions"."item_key" is not null and "moderation_actions"."publication_id" is not null)

publication_candidates_release_check.name: publication_candidates_release_check
publication_candidates_release_check.value: ("publication_candidates"."release_no" is null) = ("publication_candidates"."published_at" is null) and ("publication_candidates"."release_no" is null or "publication_candidates"."release_no" >= 1)

reports_details_check.name: reports_details_check
reports_details_check.value: "reports"."details" is null or char_length("reports"."details") between 1 and 1000

reports_closed_check.name: reports_closed_check
reports_closed_check.value: ("reports"."status" in ('resolved', 'dismissed')) = ("reports"."closed_at" is not null and "reports"."action_id" is not null)

reports_item_key_check.name: reports_item_key_check
reports_item_key_check.value: "reports"."item_key" is null or char_length("reports"."item_key") between 1 and 64

reports_target_check.name: reports_target_check
reports_target_check.value:
("reports"."target_type" = 'publication' and "reports"."publication_id" is not null and "reports"."release_id" is not null and "reports"."item_kind" is null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'publication_item' and "reports"."publication_id" is not null and "reports"."release_id" is not null and "reports"."item_kind" is not null and "reports"."item_key" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'senior_note' and "reports"."senior_note_id" is not null and "reports"."note_version" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'case_study' and "reports"."case_study_id" is not null and "reports"."case_study_version" is not null)
        or ("reports"."target_type" = 'profile' and "reports"."profile_user_id" is not null)

search_documents_target_check.name: search_documents_target_check
search_documents_target_check.value:
("search_documents"."kind" in ('case', 'stuck') and "search_documents"."publication_id" is not null and "search_documents"."release_id" is not null and "search_documents"."senior_note_id" is null
          and (("search_documents"."kind" = 'case') = ("search_documents"."item_key" is null)))
        or ("search_documents"."kind" = 'note' and "search_documents"."senior_note_id" is not null and "search_documents"."note_version" is not null and "search_documents"."publication_id" is null and "search_documents"."release_id" is null)

senior_notes_term_label_check.name: senior_notes_term_label_check
senior_notes_term_label_check.value: "senior_notes"."term_label" is null or char_length("senior_notes"."term_label") between 1 and 30

usefulness_signals_target_check.name: usefulness_signals_target_check
usefulness_signals_target_check.value:
("usefulness_signals"."target_kind" = 'stuck_item' and "usefulness_signals"."publication_id" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."item_key" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."senior_note_id" is null)
        or ("usefulness_signals"."target_kind" = 'senior_note' and "usefulness_signals"."senior_note_id" is not null and "usefulness_signals"."publication_id" is null and "usefulness_signals"."item_key" is null)

weekly_checkins_note_check.name: weekly_checkins_note_check
weekly_checkins_note_check.value: "weekly_checkins"."note" is null or char_length("weekly_checkins"."note") between 1 and 200
